text: Members of Council may file petitions.

City Council on March 25 and 26, 2026, received the following petitions for information: 1. Petition headed "Save our Swans" submitted by Councillor Amber Morley, Ward 3 - Etobicoke-Lakeshore, containing the signatures of approximately 2,300 persons. 2. Petition headed "Revitalize the Humber River - No Lease Renewal for Toronto Humber Yacht Club" submitted by Councillor Amber Morley, Ward 3 - Etobicoke-Lakeshore, containing the signatures of approximately 2,600 persons.
